descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione

In qualità di assistente di direzione, supporta proattivamente la direzione globale della nostra divisione Electrical Connectors (ECS) nelle attività operative e strategiche quotidiane. In questo ruolo chiave basato sulla fiducia, garantisce processi fluidi, coordina impegnative attività manageriali e contribuisce attivamente alla comunicazione interna e all'attuazione di progetti strategici.

Le sue mansioni

- Supporto proattivo alla direzione globale e all'alta dirigenza in questioni amministrative, organizzative e strategiche
- Preparazione di presentazioni, rapporti, analisi e documenti decisionali di alta qualità per la direzione aziendale, il Consiglio di amministrazione e la direzione del gruppo
- Organizzazione e coordinamento di appuntamenti, riunioni, viaggi di lavoro ed eventi internazionali
- Collaborazione e coordinamento di progetti negli ambiti della strategia, dello sviluppo aziendale e della comunicazione
- Ruolo di interfaccia tra la direzione, le funzioni specialistiche e i partner esterni
- Gestione di informazioni riservate e garanzia di processi professionali di gestione e comunicazione in tedesco e inglese

Requisiti

- Formazione commerciale (EFZ) o diploma commerciale, idealmente con perfezionamento come assistente di direzione e/o in economia aziendale
- Diversi anni di esperienza come Executive Assistant o assistente della direzione in un contesto esigente
- Spiccata affinità per i temi della comunicazione nonché, idealmente, esperienza in aziende internazionali e multiculturali
- Metodo di lavoro imprenditoriale, autonomo e orientato alle soluzioni, con un forte orientamento al servizio
- Personalità leale, discreta e capace di gestire situazioni stressanti, con un modo di porsi sicuro e ottime maniere
- Ottime capacità comunicative e competenza nel relazionarsi con personalità dirigenziali ai massimi livelli
- Ottima conoscenza delle applicazioni Microsoft-365 e dei moderni strumenti digitali di collaborazione
- Conoscenza del tedesco (livello C2) e dell'inglese (C1), a livello orale e scritto

Cosa offriamo:

- Un'azienda familiare svizzera attiva a livello globale, con un'ottima posizione sul mercato e soluzioni innovative ad alte prestazioni
- Una cultura aziendale basata sulla valorizzazione e collaboratori motivati che, insieme a lei, affrontano le sfide quotidiane
- I vantaggi di un'azienda di medie dimensioni, così come quelli di un gruppo internazionale
- La possibilità di contribuire allo sviluppo di tecnologie orientate al futuro
- Molti altri benefit, come orari di lavoro flessibili, un'ampia offerta interna di formazione continua, parcheggi, ulteriori giorni di ponte, postazioni di lavoro moderne e molto altro

#LI-PR1

Nota per i selezionatori:

Vi preghiamo di coordinarvi con noi prima di presentare i dossier, per chiarire le condizioni e ottenere l'accesso al portale. Grazie!
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description

As a Management Assistant, you will proactively support the global executive management of our Electrical Connectors (ECS) Division in its operational and strategic day-to-day business. In this position of trust and key role, you will ensure smooth processes, coordinate demanding management tasks and actively contribute to internal communication and the implementation of strategic projects.

Your responsibilities

- Proactive support of global executive management and top management in administrative, organizational and strategic matters
- Preparation of high-quality presentations, reports, analyses and decision-making documents for management, the Board of Directors and Group Executive Management
- Organization and coordination of appointments, meetings, business trips and international events
- Participation in and coordination of projects in the areas of strategy, corporate development and communications
- Serving as the interface between management, specialist departments and external partners
- Management of confidential information and ensuring professional management and communication processes in German and English

Requirements

- Commercial training (EFZ) or a business diploma, ideally with further training as an executive assistant and/or in business administration
- Several years of experience as an Executive Assistant or executive management assistant in a demanding environment
- Strong affinity for communications topics, ideally with experience in international and multicultural companies
- Entrepreneurial, independent and solution-oriented way of working with a strong service orientation
- Loyal, discreet and resilient personality with a confident demeanor and excellent manners
- Excellent communication skills and the ability to interact with senior executives at the highest level
- Excellent knowledge of Microsoft-365 applications and modern digital collaboration tools
- German (C2 level) and English (C1) proficiency, both spoken and written

What we offer:

- A globally operating Swiss family-owned company with a very strong market position and innovative, high-performance solutions
- An appreciative corporate culture and motivated employees who tackle daily challenges with you
- The advantages of both a medium-sized company and an international corporation
- The opportunity to contribute to forward-looking technologies
- Many other benefits, such as flexible working hours, a diverse range of internal training opportunities, parking spaces, additional days off around public holidays, modern workplaces and much more

Description

En tant que Management Assistant, vous soutenez de manière proactive la direction globale de notre division Electrical Connectors (ECS) dans ses activités opérationnelles et stratégiques quotidiennes. Dans cette fonction clé de confiance, vous veillez au bon déroulement des opérations, coordonnez des tâches de gestion exigeantes et contribuez activement à la communication interne ainsi qu’à la mise en œuvre de projets stratégiques.

- Plusieurs années d’expérience en tant qu’assistant(e) exécutif(ve) ou assistant(e) de direction dans un environnement exigeant
- Forte affinité pour les sujets liés à la communication ainsi qu’idéalement une expérience dans des entreprises internationales et multiculturelles

jobs.description:
Afin d’assurer le suivi de nos clients en Suisse, nous recherchons une personne motivée et dotée de solides compétences techniques pour occuper le poste de Field Service Engineer , basé dans la région de Neuchâtel. Dans ce poste passionnant, vous travaillerez au sein d’une équipe de service client dynamique et apporterez une contribution importante à la disponibilité et à la performance de nos solutions robotiques. L’accent est mis sur la Suisse romande, avec des déploiements occasionnels dans d’autres régions du pays.

Vos missions

• Effectuer des travaux de maintenance préventive et de réparation des systèmes robotiques directement chez le client (environ 75 % de déplacement)

• Analyse et élimination durable des défauts techniques ainsi que réalisation de réparations

• Une coopération étroite avec les clients et les services internes pour garantir un service de premier ordre

• Support technique et conseil à nos clients (hotline)

• Documentation et suivi des cas de service dans le système CRM

• Gestion et réapprovisionnement des pièces de rechange via SAP

• Formation dans le domaine technique et/ou de l’automation

• Plusieurs années d’expérience en tant que technicien de service sur le terrain

• Idéalement expérience dans le domaine de la robotique ; alternativement, connaissances en mécanique de précision, en automation ou dans des domaines techniques apparentés

• Très bonne connaissance du français (C2) et bonne maîtrise de l’anglais (C1) ; La connaissance de l’allemand est un atout

• Solides capacités d’analyse et une méthode de travail structurée et indépendante

• Une forte orientation client et très bonnes compétences en communication

• Flexibilité, volonté de voyager et apparence professionnelle même dans des situations exigeantes

• Un esprit d'équipe permettant de contribuer positivement à la cohésion et à l'entraide au sein du groupe

Nous offrons

• Un travail varié dans un environnement innovant et tourné vers l’avenir

• Des conditions de travail attrayantes et des équipements modernes

• Formation approfondie sur les produits et technique

• Haut niveau de responsabilité personnelle et d’opportunités de développement

• Coopération au sein d’une équipe professionnelle, collégiale et performante
 Nous sommes impatients de vous rencontrer et de façonner ensemble l’avenir de la robotique en Suisse. Postulez dès aujourd’hui!

In questo entusiasmante ruolo, lavorerà all'interno di un dinamico team di assistenza clienti e contribuirà in modo importante alla disponibilità e alle prestazioni delle nostre soluzioni robotiche. L'attenzione è rivolta alla Svizzera romanda, con occasionali interventi in altre regioni del Paese.

Le vostre mansioni

- Eseguire interventi di manutenzione preventiva e riparazione dei sistemi robotici direttamente presso il cliente (circa il 75 % del tempo in trasferta)
- Analisi ed eliminazione duratura dei guasti tecnici, nonché esecuzione di riparazioni
- Stretta collaborazione con i clienti e i servizi interni per garantire un servizio di prima qualità
- Supporto tecnico e consulenza ai nostri clienti (hotline)
- Documentazione e monitoraggio dei casi di assistenza nel sistema CRM
- Gestione e rifornimento dei pezzi di ricambio tramite SAP

Profilo ricercato

- Formazione in ambito tecnico e/o dell'automazione
- Diversi anni di esperienza come tecnico dell'assistenza sul campo
- Preferibilmente esperienza nel settore della robotica; in alternativa, conoscenze nella meccanica di precisione, nell'automazione o in settori tecnici affini
- Ottima conoscenza del francese (C2) e buona padronanza dell'inglese (C1); la conoscenza del tedesco costituisce un vantaggio
- Solide capacità analitiche e un metodo di lavoro strutturato e indipendente
- Forte orientamento al cliente e ottime capacità comunicative
- Flessibilità, disponibilità a viaggiare e professionalità anche in situazioni impegnative
- Uno spirito di squadra che permetta di contribuire positivamente alla coesione e al sostegno reciproco all'interno del gruppo

Offriamo

- Un lavoro vario in un ambiente innovativo e orientato al futuro
- Condizioni di lavoro interessanti e attrezzature moderne
- Formazione approfondita sui prodotti e sulla tecnica
- Elevato livello di responsabilità personale e opportunità di sviluppo
- Collaborazione all'interno di un team professionale, collegiale e performante

Non vediamo l'ora di conoscervi e di plasmare insieme il futuro della robotica in Svizzera. Candidatevi già oggi!
descriptionByLocale.en:
To ensure the follow-up of our customers in Switzerland, we are looking for a motivated person with strong technical skills to fill the position of Field Service Engineer, based in the Neuchâtel region. In this exciting role, you will work as part of a dynamic customer service team and make an important contribution to the availability and performance of our robotic solutions. The focus is on French-speaking Switzerland, with occasional assignments in other regions of the country.

Your responsibilities

- Carry out preventive maintenance and repair work on robotic systems directly at the customer's site (approximately 75% travel)
- Analyze and permanently resolve technical faults, as well as carry out repairs
- Work closely with customers and internal departments to ensure first-class service
- Technical support and advice for our customers (hotline)
- Documentation and follow-up of service cases in the CRM system
- Management and replenishment of spare parts via SAP

Candidate profile

- Training in the technical field and/or automation
- Several years of experience as a field service technician
- Ideally, experience in robotics; alternatively, knowledge of precision mechanics, automation or related technical fields
- Very good knowledge of French (C2) and good command of English (C1); knowledge of German is an asset
- Strong analytical skills and a structured, independent way of working
- Strong customer orientation and very good communication skills
- Flexibility, willingness to travel and professional appearance even in demanding situations
- A team spirit that enables you to contribute positively to cohesion and mutual support within the group

We offer

- Varied work in an innovative and forward-looking environment
- Attractive working conditions and modern equipment
- In-depth training on products and technology
- A high level of personal responsibility and development opportunities
- Cooperation within a professional, collegial and high-performing team

We look forward to meeting you and shaping the future of robotics in Switzerland together. Apply today!

- Verwaltung und Nachbestellung von Ersatzteilen über SAP

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Servicetechniker im Außendienst
- Idealerweise Erfahrung im Bereich Robotik; alternativ Kenntnisse in Feinmechanik, Automation oder verwandten technischen Bereichen
- Sehr gute Französischkenntnisse (C2) und gute Englischkenntnisse (C1); Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil
- Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten sowie eine strukturierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise
- Eine starke Kundenorientierung und sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
- Flexibilität, Reisebereitschaft und ein professionelles Auftreten auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen
- Ein Teamgeist, der es ermöglicht, positiv zum Zusammenhalt und zur gegenseitigen Unterstützung innerhalb der Gruppe beizutragen

Wir bieten

- Eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einem innovativen und zukunftsorientierten Umfeld
- Attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen und moderne Ausstattung
- Umfassende Schulung zu den Produkten und zur Technik
- Ein hohes Maß an persönlicher Verantwortung und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
- Zusammenarbeit in einem professionellen, kollegialen und leistungsstarken Team

Wir freuen uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen und gemeinsam die Zukunft der Robotik in der Schweiz zu gestalten. Bewerben Sie sich noch heute!

Mithilfe Ihres technischen und kaufmännischen Fachwissens erkennen Sie neue Chancen, gestalten Marktstrategien und unterstützen profitables Wachstum auf den globalen Märkten.

• Treiben Sie Geschäftsentwicklungsaktivitäten in allen Märkten für industrielle Tests voran, führen Sie Marktanalysen durch, identifizieren und nutzen Sie neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten, um Wachstumsziele zu erreichen.

• Definieren Sie Zielmärkte, Anwendungen und Schlüsselkunden und stellen Sie die Abstimmung von Vertriebs- und Marketingaktivitäten sicher.

• Bauen Sie Beziehungen zu strategischen Kunden und Ökosystempartnern auf, unterstützen Sie Großkunden und koordinieren Sie Kundeninteraktionen weltweit (bis zu 20 % Reisen).

• Sie fungieren als technischer und kommerzieller Experte für industrielle Testanwendungen und bieten Markteinblicke, Kundenanalysen und Unterstützung für Vertriebsteams.

• Identifizieren Sie Kundenbedürfnisse, Markttrends, Wettbewerbslücken und neue Technologien und setzen Sie Erkenntnisse in umsetzbare Eingaben für das Produktmanagement und die Entwicklung neuer Produkte um.

• Abschluss in Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau, Produktion, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Disziplin.

• Erfahrung in industriellen Tests, automatisierten Testsystemen, Produktionstechnik oder industriellen Automatisierungsumgebungen.

• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz in der Geschäftsentwicklung, Marktanalyse und Markteinführungsplanung.

• Starke Kombination aus technischem Fachwissen und kaufmännischem Scharfsinn; zusätzliche betriebswirtschaftliche oder vertriebliche Kenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

• Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Industrietechnologien, Herstellungsprozessen und/oder IoT-bezogenen Lösungen.

• Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office; Kenntnisse im Umgang mit SAP- und CRM-Systemen sind von Vorteil.

• Fließende Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich (mindestens C1-Niveau); Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil, weitere Sprachen sind von Vorteil.

• Unternehmerische, proaktive und ergebnisorientierte Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägten Fähigkeiten im Stakeholder-Management und der Fähigkeit, in einem dynamischen Umfeld erfolgreich zu sein.

jobs.title: Corporate Operations Controller
jobs.description:
As Corporate Operations Controller, you will serve as the key finance business partner to the COO and Operations Leadership Team, supporting strategic decision-making across manufacturing, procurement, planning, logistics, quality, and supply chain operations. Combining business partnering with deep operations controlling expertise, you will drive global standards, performance transparency, and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational efficiency, working capital, and business performance across the Group.
 To build a strong understanding of operational realities and foster close collaboration with key stakeholders, you will regularly visit production sites and operations teams across the Group, primarily within Europe and occasionally in the US and China. Travel will be around 20% to 30%.

Responsibilities

• Partner with the COO and Operations Leadership Team, providing financial insights, performance analysis, business cases, and decision support for manufacturing, procurement, supply chain, network design, and footprint optimization initiatives.

• Lead budgeting, forecasting, cost controlling, and performance reporting for Corporate Operations, while monitoring operational and financial KPIs and driving improvement actions.

• Own and continuously enhance global standard costing, inventory control, plant performance measurement, and operations controlling standards, policies, and reporting frameworks.

• Drive transparency and performance improvement across procurement, manufacturing, logistics, quality, inventory, productivity, forecast accuracy, working capital, and supply chain operations.

• Act as the finance lead for operational transformation projects, defining KPIs, reporting requirements, and performance measures across SAP, planning, consolidation, and BI systems.

• Strengthen the Group Controlling community through training, best-practice sharing, continuous improvement initiatives, and finance transformation projects.

• Extensive experience in Operations Finance, Supply Chain Finance, Manufacturing Finance, or Controlling within a global industrial or manufacturing environment, including experience at local production site/ factory level.

• Strong expertise in standard costing, budgeting, variance analysis, inventory management, procurement finance, performance management, and working capital optimization.

• Advanced analytical and financial modelling skills, with the ability to connect operational and financial performance and identify value creation opportunities.

• Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders, build trusted partnerships, and communicate complex topics clearly across functions and geographies.

• Experience leading international, cross-functional projects and driving operational or finance transformation initiatives.

• Strong problem-solving skills, a results-oriented mindset, and the ability to operate effectively in a matrix organization.

• Advanced knowledge of SAP (preferably S/4HANA), planning and consolidation systems, and business intelligence tools.

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Controlling, or a related field; MBA, CPA, CMA, Lean/Six Sigma, or Project Management qualifications are advantageous. Fluent English required; German and French are a plus.

At Stäubli, we value both people and performance. We hire for cultural fit and long-term collaboration, seeking a team member who is committed to being an integral part of our team for the long run.
 We start with remote interviews and move to on-site interviews as the process progresses. During the interview process you will have the opportunity to meet with the entire team to ensure a mutual fit.
 We look forward to hearing from you!
 (We accept only direct applications)

#LI-PR1

Come Corporate Operations Controller, sarai il principale partner finanziario del COO e del team di leadership operativa, supportando le decisioni strategiche in produzione, approvvigionamento, pianificazione, logistica, qualità e operazioni della supply chain. Combinando partnership aziendale con una profonda esperienza nel controllo delle operazioni, promuoverai standard globali, trasparenza delle prestazioni e iniziative di miglioramento continuo che migliorano l'efficienza operativa, il capitale circolante e le performance aziendali in tutto il Gruppo.
Per costruire una solida comprensione delle realtà operative e favorire una stretta collaborazione con gli stakeholder chiave, visiterai regolarmente siti di produzione e team operativi in tutto il Gruppo, principalmente in Europa e occasionalmente negli Stati Uniti e in Cina. I viaggi saranno intorno al 20% al 30%.

Responsabilità

• Collaborare con il COO e il team di leadership operativa, fornendo approfondimenti finanziari, analisi delle prestazioni, business case e supporto decisionale per iniziative di produzione, approvvigionamento, supply chain, progettazione di rete e ottimizzazione dell'impronta.

• Guida la gestione del budget, la previsione, il controllo dei costi e la rendicontazione delle performance per le Operazioni Aziendali, monitorando al contempo i KPI operativi e finanziari e guidando azioni di miglioramento.

• Possedere e migliorare continuamente i costi degli standard globali, il controllo dell'inventario, la misurazione delle prestazioni degli impianti e gli standard, le politiche e i quadri di rendicontazione del controllo operativo.

• Promuovere trasparenza e miglioramento delle prestazioni in ambito di acquisti, produzione, logistica, qualità, inventario, produttività, accuratezza delle previsioni, capitale circolante e operazioni della catena di approvvigionamento.

• Agire come responsabile finanziario per i progetti di trasformazione operativa, definendo KPI, requisiti di reportistica e misure di performance nei sistemi SAP, pianificazione, consolidamento e BI.

• Rafforzare la comunità di Controllo del Gruppo attraverso formazione, condivisione delle migliori pratiche, iniziative di miglioramento continuo e progetti di trasformazione finanziaria.

• Ampia esperienza in Operations Finance, Supply Chain Finance, Manufacturing Finance o Controlling in un ambiente industriale o manifatturiero globale, inclusa esperienza a livello di sito/fabbrica locale.

• Solida esperienza in calcolo standard dei costi, budgeting, analisi delle variazioni, gestione dell'inventario, finanza degli acquisti, gestione delle performance e ottimizzazione del capitale circolante.

• Competenze avanzate di analisi e modellazione finanziaria, con la capacità di collegare le performance operative e finanziarie e di identificare opportunità di creazione di valore.

• Comprovata capacità di influenzare gli stakeholder senior, costruire partnership affidabili e comunicare chiaramente temi complessi attraverso funzioni e aree geografiche.

• Esperienza nella guida di progetti internazionali e trasversali e nella conduzione di iniziative di trasformazione operativa o finanziaria.

• Forti capacità di problem solving, una mentalità orientata ai risultati e la capacità di operare efficacemente in un'organizzazione matrix.

• Conoscenze avanzate di SAP (preferibilmente S/4HANA), sistemi di pianificazione e consolidamento e strumenti di business intelligence.

• Laurea triennale in Finanza, Contabilità, Controllo o in un campo correlato; MBA, CPA, CMA, Lean/Six Sigma o Project Management sono vantaggiose. È richiesto inglese fluente; Tedesco e francese sono un vantaggio.

Da Stäubli, valorizziamo sia le persone che le prestazioni. Assumiamo per l'adattamento culturale e la collaborazione a lungo termine, cercando un membro del team impegnato a essere parte integrante del nostro team nel lungo periodo.
Iniziamo con interviste a distanza e passiamo a interviste in loco man mano che il processo procede. Durante il processo di colloquio avrai l'opportunità di incontrare l'intero team per garantire un adattamento reciproco.
Non vediamo l'ora di sentirti!
(Accettiamo solo domande dirette)

As Corporate Operations Controller, you will serve as the key finance business partner to the COO and Operations Leadership Team, supporting strategic decision-making across manufacturing, procurement, planning, logistics, quality, and supply chain operations. Combining business partnering with deep operations controlling expertise, you will drive global standards, performance transparency, and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational efficiency, working capital, and business performance across the Group.
To build a strong understanding of operational realities and foster close collaboration with key stakeholders, you will regularly visit production sites and operations teams across the Group, primarily within Europe and occasionally in the US and China. Travel will be around 20% to 30%.

Responsibilities

• Partner with the COO and Operations Leadership Team, providing financial insights, performance analysis, business cases, and decision support for manufacturing, procurement, supply chain, network design, and footprint optimization initiatives.

• Lead budgeting, forecasting, cost controlling, and performance reporting for Corporate Operations, while monitoring operational and financial KPIs and driving improvement actions.

• Own and continuously enhance global standard costing, inventory control, plant performance measurement, and operations controlling standards, policies, and reporting frameworks.

• Drive transparency and performance improvement across procurement, manufacturing, logistics, quality, inventory, productivity, forecast accuracy, working capital, and supply chain operations.

• Act as the finance lead for operational transformation projects, defining KPIs, reporting requirements, and performance measures across SAP, planning, consolidation, and BI systems.

• Strengthen the Group Controlling community through training, best-practice sharing, continuous improvement initiatives, and finance transformation projects.

• Extensive experience in Operations Finance, Supply Chain Finance, Manufacturing Finance, or Controlling within a global industrial or manufacturing environment, including experience at local production site/ factory level.

• Strong expertise in standard costing, budgeting, variance analysis, inventory management, procurement finance, performance management, and working capital optimization.

• Advanced analytical and financial modelling skills, with the ability to connect operational and financial performance and identify value creation opportunities.

• Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders, build trusted partnerships, and communicate complex topics clearly across functions and geographies.

• Experience leading international, cross-functional projects and driving operational or finance transformation initiatives.

• Strong problem-solving skills, a results-oriented mindset, and the ability to operate effectively in a matrix organization.

• Advanced knowledge of SAP (preferably S/4HANA), planning and consolidation systems, and business intelligence tools.

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Controlling, or a related field; MBA, CPA, CMA, Lean/Six Sigma, or Project Management qualifications are advantageous. Fluent English required; German and French are a plus.

At Stäubli, we value both people and performance. We hire for cultural fit and long-term collaboration, seeking a team member who is committed to being an integral part of our team for the long run.
We start with remote interviews and move to on-site interviews as the process progresses. During the interview process you will have the opportunity to meet with the entire team to ensure a mutual fit.
We look forward to hearing from you!
(We accept only direct applications)

Als Corporate Operations Controller sind Sie der wichtigste Finanzpartner des COO und des Operations Leadership Teams und unterstützen strategische Entscheidungen in den Bereichen Fertigung, Beschaffung, Planung, Logistik, Qualität und Lieferkettenoperationen. Durch die Kombination von Business Partnering und tiefgehender Expertise im Bereich Operations Controlling treiben Sie globale Standards, Leistungstransparenz und kontinuierliche Verbesserungsinitiativen voran, die die operative Effizienz, das Betriebskapital und die Unternehmensleistung in der gesamten Gruppe steigern.
Um ein gutes Verständnis der operativen Realitäten zu entwickeln und eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit wichtigen Stakeholdern zu fördern, besuchen Sie regelmäßig Produktionsstandorte und Betriebsteams in der gesamten Gruppe, hauptsächlich in Europa und gelegentlich in den USA und China. Die Reisekosten liegen bei etwa 20 % bis 30 %.

Verantwortlichkeiten

• Arbeiten Sie mit dem COO und dem Operations Leadership Team zusammen und bieten finanzielle Einblicke, Leistungsanalysen, Business Cases und Entscheidungsunterstützung für Fertigung, Beschaffung, Lieferkette, Netzwerkdesign und Footprint-Optimierungsinitiativen.

• Leitbudgetierung, Prognosen, Kostenkontrolle und Leistungsberichterstattung für den Unternehmensbetrieb sowie Überwachung der operativen und finanziellen KPIs sowie Verbesserungsmaßnahmen.

• Besitzen und kontinuierlich globale Standardkostenrechnungen, Bestandskontrolle, Leistungsmessung der Anlagen sowie Betriebssteuerungsstandards, Richtlinien und Berichtsrahmen verbessern.

• Transparenz und Leistungsverbesserung in Beschaffung, Fertigung, Logistik, Qualität, Lagerbestand, Produktivität, Prognosegenauigkeit, Betriebskapital und Lieferkettenabläufen zu fördern.

• Fungieren Sie als Finanzleiter für operative Transformationsprojekte, definieren Sie KPIs, Berichtsanforderungen und Leistungskennzahlen in SAP-, Planungs-, Konsolidierungs- und BI-Systemen.

• Stärkung der Group Controlling Community durch Schulungen, Best-Practice-Austausch, kontinuierliche Verbesserungsinitiativen und Finanztransformationsprojekte.

• Umfassende Erfahrung in Operations Finance, Supply Chain Finance, Manufacturing Finance oder Controlling innerhalb eines globalen Industrie- oder Fertigungsumfelds, einschließlich Erfahrung auf lokaler Produktionsstandort-/Fabrikebene.

• Umfassende Expertise in Standardkosten, Budgetierung, Varianzanalyse, Bestandsmanagement, Beschaffungsfinanzierung, Leistungsmanagement und Optimierung des Betriebskapitals.

• Fortgeschrittene analytische und finanzielle Modellierungsfähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, operative und finanzielle Leistung zu verknüpfen und Möglichkeiten zur Wertschöpfung zu identifizieren.

• Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, leitende Stakeholder zu beeinflussen, vertrauenswürdige Partnerschaften aufzubauen und komplexe Themen klar über Funktionen und Regionen hinweg zu kommunizieren.

• Erfahrung in der Leitung internationaler, funktionsübergreifender Projekte und in der Leitung von operativen oder finanziellen Transformationsinitiativen.

• Starke Problemlösungsfähigkeiten, eine ergebnisorientierte Denkweise und die Fähigkeit, effektiv in einer Matrixorganisation zu agieren.

• Fortgeschrittenes Wissen über SAP (vorzugsweise S/4HANA), Planungs- und Konsolidierungssysteme sowie Business-Intelligence-Tools.

• Bachelorabschluss in Finanzen, Buchhaltung, Controlling oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet; MBA-, CPA-, CMA-, Lean/Six Sigma- oder Projektmanagement-Qualifikationen sind vorteilhaft. Fließendes Englisch erforderlich; Deutsch und Französisch sind ein Plus.

Bei Stäubli schätzen wir sowohl Menschen als auch Leistung. Wir stellen für kulturelle Passung und langfristige Zusammenarbeit ein und suchen ein Teammitglied, das langfristig ein integraler Bestandteil unseres Teams ist.
Wir beginnen mit Remote-Interviews und wechseln dann zu Vor-Ort-Interviews, während der Prozess voranschreitet. Während des Interviewprozesses haben Sie die Möglichkeit, das gesamte Team zu treffen, um eine gegenseitige Passung sicherzustellen.
Wir freuen uns darauf, von Ihnen zu hören!
(Wir akzeptieren nur direkte Anträge)

En tant que contrôleur des opérations d'entreprise, vous agirez en tant que partenaire financier clé du COO et de l'équipe de direction des opérations, en soutenant la prise de décision stratégique dans les opérations de fabrication, d'approvisionnement, de planification, de logistique, de qualité et de chaîne d'approvisionnement. En combinant les partenariats commerciaux avec une expertise approfondie en contrôle des opérations, vous dirigerez les normes mondiales, la transparence des performances et les initiatives d'amélioration continue qui améliorent l'efficacité opérationnelle, le fonds de roulement et les performances commerciales dans l'ensemble du Groupe.
Pour acquérir une solide compréhension des réalités opérationnelles et favoriser une collaboration étroite avec les principales parties prenantes, vous visiterez régulièrement les sites de production et les équipes opérationnelles du Groupe, principalement en Europe et occasionnellement aux États-Unis et en Chine. Les déplacements représenteront environ 20 à 30 %.

Responsabilités

• Collaborez avec le COO et l'équipe de direction des opérations, en fournissant des informations financières, des analyses de performances, des analyses de rentabilisation et une aide à la décision pour les initiatives de fabrication, d'approvisionnement, de chaîne d'approvisionnement, de conception de réseau et d'optimisation de l'empreinte.

• Diriger la budgétisation, les prévisions, le contrôle des coûts et les rapports de performance pour les opérations d'entreprise, tout en surveillant les KPI opérationnels et financiers et en pilotant des actions d'amélioration.

• Posséder et améliorer continuellement les normes mondiales de calcul des coûts, le contrôle des stocks, la mesure des performances de l'usine et les normes, politiques et cadres de reporting des opérations.

• Favorisez la transparence et l’amélioration des performances dans les opérations d’approvisionnement, de fabrication, de logistique, de qualité, d’inventaire, de productivité, de précision des prévisions, de fonds de roulement et de chaîne d’approvisionnement.

• Agir en tant que responsable financier des projets de transformation opérationnelle, en définissant les KPI, les exigences en matière de reporting et les mesures de performance dans les systèmes SAP, de planification, de consolidation et de BI.

• Renforcer la communauté du contrôle de gestion du Groupe à travers des formations, le partage de bonnes pratiques, des initiatives d'amélioration continue et des projets de transformation financière.

• Vaste expérience en financement des opérations, en financement de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, en financement de la fabrication ou en contrôle de gestion dans un environnement industriel ou manufacturier mondial, y compris une expérience au niveau d'un site de production/d'une usine locale.

• Solide expertise en matière d'établissement des coûts standard, de budgétisation, d'analyse des écarts, de gestion des stocks, de financement des achats, de gestion des performances et d'optimisation du fonds de roulement.

• Compétences avancées en matière d'analyse et de modélisation financière, avec la capacité de relier les performances opérationnelles et financières et d'identifier les opportunités de création de valeur.

• Capacité avérée à influencer les parties prenantes de haut niveau, à établir des partenariats de confiance et à communiquer clairement sur des sujets complexes dans toutes les fonctions et zones géographiques.

• Expérience dans la direction de projets internationaux et interfonctionnels et dans la conduite d'initiatives de transformation opérationnelle ou financière.

• Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes, esprit axé sur les résultats et capacité à fonctionner efficacement dans une organisation matricielle.

• Connaissance avancée de SAP (de préférence S/4HANA), des systèmes de planification et de consolidation et des outils de business intelligence.

• Baccalauréat en finance, comptabilité, contrôle ou dans un domaine connexe ; Les qualifications MBA, CPA, CMA, Lean/Six Sigma ou en gestion de projet sont avantageuses. Anglais courant requis ; L'allemand et le français sont un plus.

Chez Stäubli, nous valorisons à la fois les personnes et la performance. Nous embauchons pour une adéquation culturelle et une collaboration à long terme, à la recherche d'un membre de l'équipe qui s'engage à faire partie intégrante de notre équipe sur le long terme.
Nous commençons par des entretiens à distance et passons à des entretiens sur place au fur et à mesure que le processus progresse. Au cours du processus d'entretien, vous aurez l'occasion de rencontrer toute l'équipe pour assurer une adéquation mutuelle.
Nous sommes impatients de vous entendre !

Descrizione

Siamo alla ricerca di un dirigente esperto nell’ambito della R&S per guidare il nostro Center of Excellence Renewable Energy / MC4 Line . In questo ruolo, avrà la responsabilità complessiva del portafoglio prodotti a Lei assegnato e guiderà lo sviluppo dei prodotti, l’industrializzazione, la gestione del ciclo di vita e il miglioramento continuo dei prodotti presso i siti di sviluppo in Europa, Cina e negli USA.

Garantisce che i nostri prodotti rimangano competitivi, scalabili e conformi alle normative, nonché in linea con i requisiti del mercato, guidando al contempo un'organizzazione globale composta da dirigenti, ingegneri e specialisti tecnici.

Le sue mansioni

- Guida strategica e operativa del Center of Excellence, nonché responsabilità del raggiungimento degli obiettivi di performance e crescita
- Responsabilità end-to-end dei prodotti assegnati ai siti di sviluppo in Europa, Cina e USA durante l'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto
- Garantire la competitività sul mercato e rispetto alla concorrenza attraverso l'innovazione, la scalabilità, la localizzazione e l'ottimizzazione dei costi
- Leadership tecnologica e rappresentanza del Center of Excellence nei confronti degli stakeholder interni ed esterni, dei clienti, dei partner e dei fornitori
- Promozione dell'eccellenza tecnica e metodologica all'interno dell'organizzazione
- Sviluppo, introduzione e garanzia di standard, processi e migliori pratiche uniformi
- Elaborazione e attuazione di misure derivanti dalla strategia aziendale e dai relativi piani aziendali
- Gestione del portafoglio di prodotti e progetti tenendo conto dei requisiti del mercato, delle risorse e delle priorità strategiche
- Monitoraggio dei KPI, dei budget, delle risorse, dei rischi e dell'avanzamento dei progetti
- Garanzia della qualità dei prodotti, della conformità, della sicurezza dei prodotti e del rispetto dei requisiti interni ed esterni in materia di audit e approvazione
- Comunicazione trasparente dei progressi, dei rischi e delle opportunità agli stakeholder rilevanti

Requisiti

- Laurea conseguita in ingegneria meccanica, ingegneria elettrica o in una disciplina tecnica equivalente.
- Pluriennale esperienza professionale e manageriale nel settore dello sviluppo di prodotti destinati alla produzione in grandi serie di componenti elettromeccanici
- Esperienza nello sviluppo di connettori
- Conoscenza delle norme specifiche di settore, dei requisiti normativi e degli standard qualitativi pertinenti
- Comprovata esperienza nella gestione di organizzazioni internazionali di R&D e nella gestione di programmi di sviluppo complessi in più sedi, inclusa la gestione di budget, risorse, rischi e tempistiche.
- Solide conoscenze nei settori della gestione del ciclo di vita del prodotto, della gestione del portafoglio, dell'industrializzazione dei prodotti e dello sviluppo di prodotti orientato al mercato.
- Esperienza nell'uso di sistemi PLM ed ERP; la conoscenza di applicazioni CAD e CAE come AutoCAD, Inventor o SolidWorks costituisce un vantaggio.
- Ottima conoscenza dell'inglese scritto e parlato, nonché buona conoscenza del tedesco scritto e parlato.
- Un'ulteriore formazione in economia aziendale o un Executive-MBA costituiscono un vantaggio.

Cosa offriamo:

- Un'azienda familiare svizzera operante a livello globale, con un'ottima posizione sul mercato e soluzioni innovative ad alte prestazioni
- Una cultura aziendale improntata alla valorizzazione e collaboratori motivati che affrontano con voi le sfide quotidiane
- I vantaggi di un'azienda di medie dimensioni così come quelli di un gruppo internazionale
- La possibilità di contribuire allo sviluppo di tecnologie orientate al futuro
- Molti altri benefit, come orari di lavoro flessibili, un'offerta variegata di formazione interna, parcheggi, ulteriori giorni ponte, postazioni di lavoro moderne e molto altro

Description

We are looking for an experienced R&D leader to head our Center of Excellence Renewable Energy / MC4 Line. In this role, you will have overall responsibility for the assigned product portfolio and lead product development, industrialization, lifecycle management and continuous product improvement at the development sites in Europe, China and the USA.

You will ensure that our products remain competitive, scalable and compliant, and meet market requirements, while leading a global organization of managers, engineers and technical specialists.

Your responsibilities

- Strategic and operational leadership of the Center of Excellence and responsibility for achieving performance and growth targets
- End-to-end responsibility for the assigned products of the development sites in Europe, China and the USA throughout the entire product lifecycle
- Ensuring market and competitive viability through innovation, scaling, localization and cost optimization
- Technological leadership and representation of the Center of Excellence to internal and external stakeholders, customers, partners and suppliers
- Promoting technical and methodological excellence within the organization
- Developing, implementing and ensuring consistent standards, processes and best practices
- Deriving and implementing measures based on the corporate strategy and relevant business plans
- Managing the product and project portfolio while taking market requirements, resources and strategic priorities into account
- Monitoring KPIs, budgets, resources, risks and project progress
- Ensuring product quality, compliance, product safety and adherence to internal and external audit and approval requirements
- Transparent communication of progress, risks and opportunities to relevant stakeholders

Requirements

- Completed university degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering or a comparable technical field.
- Several years of professional and leadership experience in product development for high-volume production of electromechanical components
- Experience in the development of connectors
- Knowledge of relevant industry-specific standards, regulatory requirements and quality standards
- Proven experience leading international R&D organizations and managing complex development programs across multiple locations, including the management of budgets, resources, risks and schedules.
- In-depth knowledge of product lifecycle management, portfolio management, product industrialization and market-oriented product development.
- Experience working with PLM and ERP systems; knowledge of CAD and CAE applications such as AutoCAD, Inventor or SolidWorks is an advantage.
- Excellent written and spoken English skills as well as good written and spoken German skills.
- Additional training in business administration or an Executive MBA is an advantage.

What we offer:

- A globally active Swiss family-owned company with a very strong market position and innovative high-performance solutions
- An appreciative corporate culture and motivated employees who tackle the daily challenges with you
- The advantages of a medium-sized company as well as those of an international corporation
- The opportunity to contribute to forward-looking technologies
- Many other benefits such as flexible working hours, a diverse internal training program, parking spaces, additional bridge days, modern workplaces and much more

You not only want to analyze figures, but also derive concrete decisions from them? For our newly created position, we are looking for a Senior Division Procurement Controller/Business Partner who makes the financial performance of our procurement transparent, critically scrutinized and continuously developed together with Procurement, Finance and Operations.
In this role, you combine your financial and controlling expertise with a deep understanding of purchasing and industrial value creation. They create transparency about savings, material costs, PPV, COGS, margins, cash and working capital and translate these into clear recommendations for action for management.
You will accompany our global procurement activities in Europe, North America, China and India and make a direct contribution to the profitability, cash flow and competitiveness of the division.
Their tasks

• Establishment, control and further development of global procurement controlling, which will include the definition and harmonization of a globally uniform KPI methodology, dashboard and management reporting.

• Control and validation of savings, cost avoidance, PPV and other procurement performance indicators.

• Developing a transparent savings pipeline from initiative to implementation to actual impact on results.

• Analysis of the global material cost development by product group, supplier, region and product; also identification of cost, risk and optimization potential including derivation of concrete measures.

• Support in budget, forecast and strategic planning processes for material costs, acting as a sparring partner for global procurement, finance and operations.

• Identification of financial potential in the areas of Payment Terms, DPO, MOQ, Incoterms and Total Cost of Ownership.

• Support for location, supplier and sourcing comparisons.

• Identification and financial evaluation of supplier, cost and supply chain risks, as well as supporting strategic decisions to optimize our global supplier footprint.

• Completed studies in finance, controlling, business administration, industrial engineering or a comparable field of study

• Several years of relevant professional experience in procurement controlling, supply chain finance, operations controlling, material cost controlling or finance business partnering, ideally in an international industrial company

• Very good understanding of the relationships between procurement, material costs, COGS, gross margin, cash and working capital

• Good understanding of industrial value creation, such as BOM structures, material costs, standard costs and manufacturing costs

• Excel skills, ideally including Power Query and Pivot

• Experience with Power BI, Qlik or comparable BI solutions

• Good SAP knowledge, especially in MM and FI/CO; CO-PA knowledge is an advantage

• Negotiable German and English

What to expect

• A newly created global key role with a high degree of creative freedom

• Direct collaboration with Divison Operations Controlling and Head of Global Procurement

• International responsibility with focus on Europe, North America, China and India

• The opportunity to significantly shape global procurement performance management

• Visible impact on profitability, cash, working capital and competitiveness

• A role in which your analyses flow directly into strategic and operational decisions
